body:
!THIS DATA PACK IS ONLY FOR 1.19.4!

Details of Flora is a Data Pack that improves world generation, making trees taller than vanilla ones.
Given to the world a different feel than vanilla.

Biomes with the most noticeable changes:
- Jungle
- Sparse Jungle
- Birch Forest
- Forest
- Flower Forest
- Taiga
- Dark Forest
- Swamp
- Snowy Plains
- Snowy Taiga
- Desert
- Old Growth Birch Forest
- Savanna
- Savanna Plateau
- Plains
